title: Kanye West Appears To Unfollow Nicki Minaj On IG After Clown Comment
htmlContent:
It seems Kanye West's friendship with Nicki Minaj took a turn for the worse.

After Kanye opened the door to Nicki to drop one of the most iconic verses of her career to this day on "Monster" in 2010. The Dark Fantasy hit record plays a role in the rift between West and Nicki more than ten years later.

As for July 11th, 2022, If you try to type Nicki's name in Ye's follow list she can't be found. Following her comments referencing West as a 'Clown' at Essence Fest in New Orleans. However, Nicki is currently still following the Donda artist.

“A monster though!” Minaj began. “A monster though! But we don’t fuck with clowns.”

News immediately began to spread that Nicki's comments could have been related to West working with Cardi B on her new project, “Hot Shit” with Lil Durk last week, and the video is slated to drop on Tuesday. Cardi and Nicki have a well-documented checked past with each other.

Speaking of Nicki Minaj, recently during a Instagram shared that she was pregnant.

“Am I pregnant?” “Oh, I did mean to tweet this: I’m not fat, y’all, I’m pregnant,” said Minaj.

She would later backtrack and said she said it wrong.

“Oh wait,” said Minaj. “Did I say it wrong? I’m sorry. I think I said it wrong. I meant to say I’m not pregnant, I’m fat.”
